methods.note: The paper's own method is a gem5 -> McPAT/CACTI-3DD -> HotSpot 7.0 steady-state flow on a 3-layer stack with a passive heat sink (PDF pp. 5-6, 9-10), and the text supports this. The extraction nonetheless sets experiment.kind to custom_2d_steady while its own physical_mismatches mark the 3D stack, vertical coupling, cooling path and per-layer behaviour as essential. A 2D steady reproduction would contradict the decisive 3D features, so it cannot be called a reproduction of this scenario.

code.note: The GitHub repo (PDF pp. 1, 13) is described as 'in the process of being released'. No pinned asset was supplied (assets list is empty), so the modified McPAT, parser, floorplan designer and cooling generator cannot be inspected. Third-party parser URLs (refs [40]-[42]) are bare URLs and are not evidence. The 'checked_links_found' status only confirms that links exist, not that code is available.

parameters.note: Table VI values (4 cores, 2 GHz, OoO 8-issue, L1 4KB/8KB 2-way, shared L2 2MB, 8GB/32 banks/8 per rank, 3 layers, bank ranges 16-31/0-15, cores 0-3) are present in the pdftotext output on PDF p. 9. Decisive thermal parameters are absent: layer thicknesses, materials, heat sink and convection, ambient temperature, grid resolution, die area, and per-block or total power. The 3 maximum temperatures come from figure titles in text only, so the decisive observable is not independently verified.

config.note: No HotSpot 7.0 stack, floorplan, cooling or Cool-3D YAML configuration is in the packet. Fig. 9 shows only unit labels (C0_IALU, B_0, ...) without numeric geometry. Stack order and passive-heat-sink cooling are verified from Table VI text, but the heat-sink position relative to the stack is only implied (pp. 9-10).

data.note: No per-block power, floorplan coordinates, gem5/McPAT outputs, or numeric temperature tables are published or supplied. The empty floorplan and power_w in the extraction are honest, but the experiment cannot be run. Fig. 9 was not visually verified: only text extraction was supplied, with no page images and no assets. The values 395.52/392.83/390.57 K are verified only from extracted title text, not from the rendered figure.

findings.reason: The kind is 'custom_2d_steady' while the scenario is a 3-die stack with a passive heat sink and the extraction itself flags 3D coupling and the cooling path as essential mismatches. Calling it a 2D reproduction contradicts those decisive 3D features.
findings.locator: extraction.experiment vs physical_mismatches[0-1]; PDF p. 9 Table VI, p. 10 Fig. 9

findings.reason: Both are empty. No floorplan block has same-scenario power, and no geometry exists, so no block-level thermal run is supported. Any generated 2D shelf coordinates or constant power would be illustrative assumptions, not published data.

The values are read from pdftotext of figure titles. No rendered page image was supplied, so the figure and its association with the correct panel were not visually verified. The observable is also per-layer maximum, not a stack-level figure.

The text says temperatures were 'digitized from the Fig. 9 heat-map color-bar labels', but the evidence entries say they are read from the printed titles. The provenance statements are inconsistent. The color bar spans only about 384-394 K, which does not itself contain 395.52 K.

The mismatches discuss a 'Studio' 2D model that is never defined in the paper or packet, and studio_assumptions is empty although the scenario implies a substitute model. Substitute assumptions (geometry, power, materials) are unstated.
Page citation 'PDF pages 4, 10-13' is imprecise. The future-work statement on RL optimization is on p. 13, and page 4 does not support the claim.
The repo is called 'in the process of being released' and no pinned file exists, so release is unverified. Code and experiment data cannot be treated as available.
